Hello Chetouah, good morning. I hope you are doing well today.
I checked the logs and you are absolutely correct, can you please tell me if you have faced this issue after v8.1.4? At 22/Sep this version was not available yet and I don't see the error anymore on the logs.
I can see some logs that say "Communication Timeout" and that can be the reason why it didn't get acknowledged by our system.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
